plan.title: Closed RFQ Event Detailed Report Download

steps.note: Open the API-prepared closed RFQ on the buyer's summary page.
Navigate to the RFQ stage named by the case.
Open the RFQ Responses tab before using its Download Report control.
Open the Download Reports window from the Responses screen.
Assert that the Download Reports window opened.
Verify the requested default report type is selected.
Verify the requested default report format is selected.
Request the Excel report after selecting all fields.
Assert that the Excel report downloaded successfully.
